episodes.name: Classic Rock (1)
episodes.overviewEn:
In a fight with Black Adam on the Rock of Eternity several Djinns get released and the Justice League has to stop them.

Part one of a four part episode also known as Shazam Slam.
episodes.overviewAr: في قتال مع بلاك آدم، تتحرر مجموعة من الجن. الجزء الأول من أربعة.

episodes.name: Power Outage (2)
episodes.overviewEn:
A lava based Djinn absorbes the powers of Parasite giving Wonder Woman and Superman a hard time beating a creature that drains them of their own powers.

Part two of a four part episode also known as Shazam Slam.
episodes.overviewAr: جنّي من الحمم يمتص قوى باراسايت، وووندر وومان وسوبرمان في ورطة. الجزء الثاني.

episodes.name: Night of the Bat (3)
episodes.overviewEn:
Batman is possessed by a djinn who overloads and power core from the Hall of Justice.

Part three of a four part episode also known as Shazam Slam.
episodes.overviewAr: جنّي يتلبّس باتمان ويهدد مقر الأبطال. الجزء الثالث.

episodes.name: Abate and Switch (4)
episodes.overviewEn:
The last three djinn are proving formidable foes when Black Adam shows up again with a vengeance. With the help of John Constantine, Plastic Man, Swamp Thing and Shazam the League puts in a team effort to stop Black Adam and the djinn. At the site of the battle the watchtower is built as a replacement HQ.

Part four of a four part episode also known as Shazam Slam.
episodes.overviewAr: الجن الثلاثة الأخيرون خصوم أشداء، وبلاك آدم يعود. الجزء الرابع.

episodes.name: Follow That Space Cab!
episodes.overviewEn: Superman and Hawkman receive the help of an honorable space cab driver as they try to protect Mr. Mind from being captured by Lobo.
episodes.overviewAr: سوبرمان وهوكمان يستعينان بسائق أجرة فضائي شريف في مطاردة بين النجوم.

episodes.name: Nuclear Family Values
episodes.overviewEn: Firestorm's family values. The heat is on when the Justice League enlist the help of Firestorm. Taking a trip to where it all began, Firestorm encounters a not so all American family.
episodes.overviewAr: الفريق يستعين بفايرستورم حين تستولي «العائلة النووية» على محطة طاقة.

episodes.name: Zombie King
episodes.overviewEn: Batman teams up with John Constantine, Zatanna, and Swamp Thing when Solomon Grundy tries to raise a zombie army
episodes.overviewAr: باتمان يتعاون مع جون كونستنتين وزاتانا وسوامب ثينغ حين يُحيي سولومون غراندي جيشاً من الزومبي.

episodes.name: Galaxy Jest
episodes.overviewEn: Wonder Woman and Superman have to rescue Joker from Mongul, whilst Batman and Flash try to stop a massive laughing gas bomb hidden away in Gotham.
episodes.overviewAr: على ووندر وومان وسوبرمان إنقاذ الجوكر من مونغول، الذي خطفه ليُضحكه.

episodes.name: Time Share
episodes.overviewEn: Batman and Blue Beetle are thrown back in time where they must stop Chronos from destroying Batman on his first night in Gotham where he faces off against Carmine Falcone and his men.
episodes.overviewAr: باتمان وبلو بيتل يُقذفان إلى الماضي، وعليهما منع كرونوس من محو باتمان من التاريخ.

episodes.name: Under a Red Sun
episodes.overviewEn: After a brief team up with Batman and Big Barda in their battle against the Parademons, Superman is transported to a planet orbiting a red sun by Steppenwolf. This is part of Steppenwolf's plan to kill Superman and become a legend. Now with his powers slowly depleting, Superman must defeat Steppenwolf and get back to Earth. As this is happening, Batman and Big Barda head to Darkseid's fortress on Apokolips in order to find information on where Superman is transported to.
episodes.overviewAr: سوبرمان يعلق على كوكب شمسه حمراء فيفقد قواه، وخصمه القديم يطارده.

episodes.name: Play Date
episodes.overviewEn: When the Justice League Watchtower is invaded by Toyman and his army oftoys, Cyborg, Wonder Woman, Superman, and Batman are turned into players in a twisted version of a fighting game, and now Cyborg will need all of his gaming skills to get out of this one.
episodes.overviewAr: تويمان وجيشه من الألعاب يجتاحون مقر الفريق، وسايبورغ محور اللعبة.

episodes.name: Repulse!
episodes.overviewEn: Superman has been infected by the "Repulse", who was revealed as Lex Luthor, and has now become the new Repulse. As Wonder Woman and Hawkman try to find a way to save him, Superman must remove those nanobots from his body by sending them into a black hole before he gets pulled into it as well.
episodes.overviewAr: سوبرمان يُصاب بعدوى تجعل كل من يقترب منه يُقذَف بعيداً، وليكس لوثر وراءها.

episodes.name: Trick or Threat
episodes.overviewEn: Cain the Caretaker tells the audience a Halloween story about the House of Mystery, where Batman, Zatanna, Constantine, and Doctor Fate are turned into 10-year-olds by Klarion the Witch Boy. Now, the 10-year-old Justice League must find a way to defeat Klarion, turn them back to normal, and escape the House of Mystery before it disappears by midnight.
episodes.overviewAr: قصة هالوين: أربعة من الأبطال الصغار يدخلون بيتاً مسكوناً.

episodes.name: Speed Demon
episodes.overviewEn: After defeating Harley Quinn, Batman and Zatanna encounter Brother Night who used his dark magic to control the Batmobile and kidnapping Zatanna. With the help of Etrigan the Demon, Batman must save her, stop the Batmobile, and defeat Brother Night.
episodes.overviewAr: باتمان وزاتانا يواجهان ساحراً يستحوذ على الباتموبيل.

episodes.name: Hat Trick
episodes.overviewEn: Felix Faust steals Zatanna's hat in order to free a massive demon and get his youth back. While Batman and Etrigan face off against the demon, Zatanna uses every trick in her arsenal to get her hat back from Felix Faust.
episodes.overviewAr: فيلكس فاوست يسرق قبعة زاتانا ليحرّر شيطاناً عملاقاً ويستعيد شبابه.

episodes.name: Luthor in Paradise
episodes.overviewEn: Lex Luthor and Circe invade Themyscira, home of the Amazons, to obtain a staff that leads to the Fallen Realm and an artifact of the Greek Gods. With help from Superman and Batman, Wonder Woman must find a way to stop those villains before it's too late.
episodes.overviewAr: ليكس لوثر وسيرسي يغزوان ثيميسكيرا، جزيرة الأمازونيات، للحصول على عصا سحرية.

episodes.name: Plastic Man Saves the World
episodes.overviewEn: While Superman, Batman, Cyborg, and Vixen try to stop Brainiac, Plastic Man sneaks into Brainiac's spaceship to destroy the shrink ray and save the world in order to prove that he is a worthy superhero.
episodes.overviewAr: سوبرمان وباتمان وسايبورغ وفيكسن يحاولون إيقاف برينياك، وبلاستيك مان يتسلل إلى سفينته وحده.

episodes.name: Field Trip
episodes.overviewEn: As Superman gives Blue Beetle, Firestorm, and Stargirl a tour of the Fortress of Solitude, they run afoul with General Zod, Faora, and an unidentified Kryptonian villain who are accidentally freed from the Phantom Zone. Now with Superman trapped inside, the three teen heroes must work together to stop the Kryptonian villains.
episodes.overviewAr: سوبرمان يأخذ بلو بيتل وفايرستورم وستارغيرل في جولة داخل قلعته، ثم يُحبَس في فانتوم زون.

episodes.name: Rage of the Red Lanterns
episodes.overviewEn: Lobo stole the rings from the Red Lanterns and pits Atrocitus, Zilius Zox and the rest of the Red Lanterns against Batman, Superman, and Wonder Woman in order to get a score. After Lobo unlocked the Spider Gauntlet's power, the Justice League and the Red Lanterns must team up to defeat him.
episodes.overviewAr: لوبو يسرق خواتم ريد لانترنز ويثير حرباً.

episodes.name: Freezer Burn
episodes.overviewEn: Mr. Freeze flies on his aircraft to freeze the entire Gotham City using Killer Frost as his power source. While Batman deals with Mr. Freeze, Firestorm will have to save Killer Frost and develops a crush on her at the same time.
episodes.overviewAr: مستر فريز يسعى لتجميد غوثام كلها باستخدام كيلر فروست.

episodes.name: Inside Job
episodes.overviewEn: In a Fantastic Voyage-like adventure, Atom shrinks Batman and Wonder Woman, so they can enter Superman's bloodstream and destroy a lethal nanite virus.
episodes.overviewAr: أتوم يقلّص باتمان وووندر وومان ليدخلوا جسد سوبرمان ويخرجوا منه ما يهدد حياته.

episodes.name: The Trouble with Truth
episodes.overviewEn: The JLA find themselves in danger of losing Wonder Woman when the goddess Athena comes to Earth with an offer Diana can't refuse -- filling the position of the Goddess of Truth on Mt. Olympus.
episodes.overviewAr: الأبطال مهددون بخسارة ووندر وومان حين تُستدعى للعودة إلى موطنها.

episodes.name: Double Cross
episodes.overviewEn: In order for Batman to lure Deadshot into a trap, he has Plastic Man pose as Two-Face. Things go well at first until the real Two-Face escapes from Firestorm's custody.
episodes.overviewAr: ليستدرج ديدشوت إلى فخ، يجعل باتمان بلاستيك مان ينتحل شخصية تو-فيس.

episodes.name: Battle for the Bottled City
episodes.overviewEn: The Atom shrinks Superman down to microscopic size so that he can enter the Bottled City of Kandor but when Brainiac breaks into the Fortress of Solitude, defeats Cyborg, and reclaims the bottle, Atom must try to stop Brainiac on his own.
episodes.overviewAr: أتوم يقلّص سوبرمان إلى حجم مجهري ليدخل المدينة المحبوسة في القارورة.

episodes.name: Garden of Evil
episodes.overviewEn: When Swamp Thing has a blind date with Poison Ivy which leads to her controlling him in her plot to overrun Gotham City with plants, Batman works on an antidote to free Swamp Thing from Poison Ivy's control. Meanwhile, Poison Ivy is collaborating with Harley Quinn to help her keep Swamp Thing in check. So Superman, Firestorm, and Vixen work to fight Poison Ivy and Harley Quinn on their home turf.
episodes.overviewAr: سوامب ثينغ يخرج في موعد مع بويزن آيفي، فتتحكم فيه لتغزو المدينة بالنباتات.

episodes.name: All Aboard the Space Train
episodes.overviewEn: In a strange turn of events, the JLA enlist the help of Space Cabbie and Jonah Hex to stop the hijacking of an intergalactic space train.
episodes.overviewAr: الأبطال يستعينون بسائق الأجرة الفضائي وجونا هِكس لإيقاف سطو على قطار فضائي.

episodes.name: Time Out
episodes.overviewEn: Batman teams up with Booster Gold when an alien creature starts literally eating up time.
episodes.overviewAr: باتمان يتعاون مع بوستر غولد حين يبدأ مخلوق فضائي بالتهام الزمن نفسه.

episodes.name: The Fatal Fare
episodes.overviewEn: Space Cabbie inadvertently learns about a great threat to the Justice League when one of his passengers turns out to be Darkseid.
episodes.overviewAr: سائق الأجرة الفضائي يعرف بالمصادفة عن خطر كبير يهدد الفريق.

episodes.name: Mxy's Mix-Up
episodes.overviewEn: As the Justice League tries to protect the United Nations from Gorilla Grodd gorilla army, Mister Mxyzptlk pops up from the fifth dimension and thinks it would be great fun to....
episodes.overviewAr: مكسيزبتلك يخلط عقول الأبطال بأجساد بعضهم وهم يحاولون حماية الأمم المتحدة من غوريلا غرود.

episodes.name: Supernatural Adventures in Babysitting
episodes.overviewEn: Stargirl has to enlist Constantine's help when Klarion the Witch Boy takes the place of the boy she's supposed to be babysitting...
episodes.overviewAr: ستارغيرل تجالس طفلاً، ثم تضطر إلى الاستعانة بكونستنتين حين يتدخل فتى ساحر.

episodes.name: Booster's Gold
episodes.overviewEn: Green Arrow becomes involved with Booster Gold when he discovers that the self-centered superhero has brought dinosaurs back from the past for a money-making venture.
episodes.overviewAr: غرين آرو يكتشف أن بوستر غولد يخبئ شيئاً من المستقبل.

episodes.name: Boo-ray for Bizarro
episodes.overviewEn: The Justice League is back, "with lightning-paced action and heroics.” This show will be including everyone: Superman. Batman, Wonder Woman, Hawkman, Green Arrow, Zatanna
episodes.overviewAr: بيزارو يحاول «مساعدة» الأبطال بطريقته المعكوسة.

episodes.name: Best Day Ever
episodes.overviewEn: Joker frees Luthor with a mother box and forces him to spend the day together, hopping all over the world, with the Justice League hot on their trail trying to catch up.
episodes.overviewAr: الجوكر يحرّر ليكس لوثر ويجبره على قضاء يوم كامل معه.

episodes.name: The Cube Root
episodes.overviewEn: When a mysterious alien abducts Mr. Terrific, Batman, Luthor and two of the brainiest villains in the universe, he puts them to a test to discover who is the smartest among them.
episodes.overviewAr: مكعب فضائي غامض يهدد الفريق، وفايرستورم ومستر تريفيك مفتاح الحل.

episodes.name: Superman's Pal, Sid Sharp
episodes.overviewEn: Reporter Sid Sharp has aspirations on becoming a superhero.
episodes.overviewAr: صحفي متطفل يطمح إلى أن يصير بطلاً خارقاً.

episodes.name: Superman Red vs Superman Blue
episodes.overviewEn: Luthor comes up with a new device to defeat Superman. But the kryptonite emitter has the unexpected ability to, once hit, separate each Justice Leaguer in two, one passive and good (blue), the other aggressive and mean (red).
episodes.overviewAr: جهاز جديد من لوثر يشطر سوبرمان إلى اثنين: أحمر وأزرق.

episodes.name: The Ringer
episodes.overviewEn: Sinestro's ring is suddenly much more powerful than usual, so the Justice League sends a microscopic Atom into his ring to find out what the cause might be.
episodes.overviewAr: خاتم سينسترو صار أقوى كثيراً من المعتاد، والفريق يبحث عن السبب.

episodes.name: Forget Me Not
episodes.overviewEn: When Firestorm discovers that League members have no memory of who they are, it's up to him to round them up in their secret identities and convince them they are superheroes.
episodes.overviewAr: فايرستورم يكتشف أن أعضاء الفريق نسوا من يكونون، وعليه تذكيرهم.

episodes.name: The Brain Buster
episodes.overviewEn: A mysterious creature abducts Batman, Mr. Terrific, Luthor and two of the brainiest villains in the universe to put them to the test to discover who is the smartest among them.
episodes.overviewAr: مخلوق غامض يخطف باتمان ومستر تريفيك ولوثر وأذكى عقول العالم ليختبرهم.

episodes.name: E. Nigma, Consulting Detective
episodes.overviewEn: When the Joker traps Batman, the Justice League allows Riddler to help them find him.
episodes.overviewAr: الجوكر يحبس باتمان، والفريق يسمح لريدلر بمساعدته في العثور عليه.

episodes.name: Harley Goes Ape!
episodes.overviewEn: When Gorilla Grodd takes control over Titano, only Harley Quinn can reach him.
episodes.overviewAr: غوريلا غرود يسيطر على قرد عملاق، ولا يستطيع الوصول إليه إلا هارلي كوين.

episodes.name: Phased and Confused
episodes.overviewEn: When members of the Justice League are affected by the Phantom Zone ray and become phantom-like, their only hope for freedom is to somehow get a message to Booster Gold.
episodes.overviewAr: شعاع فانتوم زون يصيب بعض أعضاء الفريق فيصيرون أشباحاً غير مرئيين.

episodes.name: It'll Take a Miracle
episodes.overviewEn: Batman needs help from the new God Mr. Miracle to stop one of Darkseid's evil plans. But Batman first has to catch the universes greatest escape artist.
episodes.overviewAr: باتمان يحتاج عون مستر ميراكل، فنّان الهروب، لإحباط مخطط لدارك سايد.

episodes.name: System Error
episodes.overviewEn: Trapped in a “pocket dimension” the Justice League has to fight in an endless simulation that Darkseid can reset over and over again. Its up to the Batman to come up with an escape plan and contact the Justice League?
episodes.overviewAr: الفريق محبوس في بُعد صغير وعليه القتال في محاكاة لا تنتهي.

episodes.name: Race Against Crime
episodes.overviewEn: Superman and Flash race for charity only to fall into a trap set by Lex Luthor. With the help of time traveling supervillain Chronos, Luthor has build a "time" suit that allows him to control everyone's speed.
episodes.overviewAr: سوبرمان وفلاش يتسابقان في سباق خيري، ويقعان في فخ نصبه ليكس لوثر.

episodes.name: Party Animal
episodes.overviewEn: Green Arrow and Plastic Man just caught Solomon Grundy, who ends up with them at the the annual Justice League Christmas party, what can go wrong? It all works out with help of Batman, the Flash and the spirit of Christmas. Although Green Arrow tries his best, the rest of the League decides to go to the S.T.A.R. labs Christmas party after all.
episodes.overviewAr: غرين آرو وبلاستيك مان يقبضان على سولومون غراندي، فينتهي معهما في حفل عيد الميلاد.

episodes.name: Watchtower Tours
episodes.overviewEn: When Booster Gold starts to secretly give tours of the Watchtower to make some extra cash, he inadvertently brings in at least one super-villain disguised as a tourist.
episodes.overviewAr: بوستر غولد يبدأ سرّاً بتنظيم جولات سياحية في مقر الفريق ليكسب مالاً إضافياً.

episodes.name: Barehanded
episodes.overviewEn: When Green Lantern leaves his ring in an intergalactic restroom after washing his hands, he discovers it's gone, leading him on a wild chase for the aliens who might have taken it.
episodes.overviewAr: غرين لانترن ينسى خاتمه في دورة مياه بين المجرّات، وعليه استعادته بلا قوى.

episodes.name: Captain Bamboozle
episodes.overviewEn: Mr. Mxyzptlk decides to create some mischief by granting Shazam's well-meaning Uncle Dudley with superpowers bigger than anyone in the league.
episodes.overviewAr: مكسيزبتلك يمنح عمّ شازام الطيب قوى خارقة ليثير الفوضى.

episodes.name: Keeping Up with the Kryptonians
episodes.overviewEn: Mr. Mxyzptlk shows Supergirl and Superman that their innate goodness might not be so pure when he takes them to a parallel world where their counterparts are impossibly aggressive and spoiled.
episodes.overviewAr: مكسيزبتلك يُري سوبرغيرل وسوبرمان عالماً نشآ فيه نشأة مختلفة.

episodes.name: Unleashed
episodes.overviewEn: While the Justice League is away on a mission, Plastic Man is not only left in charge of the Watchtower, but also of Krypto Superman's not so ordinary dog.
episodes.overviewAr: الفريق في مهمة بعيدة، وبلاستيك مان متروك وحده لحراسة المقر، ومعه كلب سوبرمان.

episodes.name: She Wore Red Velvet
episodes.overviewEn: When Booster and the Justice League come under attack by a mysterious and unrelenting new villainess known as Red Velvet, Booster comes to realize she's actually the fiance he left at the altar in the future.
episodes.overviewAr: بوستر غولد والفريق يتعرضون لهجوم خصم غامض لا يلين، ولها حساب قديم مع بوستر. الحلقة الأخيرة.
